text:
Nora Li: Olga asked for a compact deliverable tying a single RBAC change to subsequent KMS usage (Oct-Dec 2023). They want one end-to-end example + a CSV mapping. Who can assemble minimal bundle and redact IDs?

Diego Alvarez: I can pull the bits. Plan: (1) git diff for infra/roles in range, (2) k8s audit extract for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding create/patch, (3) CloudTrail filter for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Encrypt on our key ARNs. Will produce one anchor example row and bulk CSV.

Priya Singh: Redaction rules: emails -> sha256(email); human-readable service names kept, full ARNs for service principals only if requested. Redaction key stored in vault path secret/audit/redact/2023-q4. Auditor OK?

Olga (Auditor): Redactions accepted if mapping is made available to engagement lead under NDA. Also include brief note on time sync across systems (we accept UTC-based logs).

Diego Alvarez: Sample commands I'll use (saved to manifest):
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2023-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2023-12-31T23:59:59Z > raw_kms.json
jq -r '.Events[] | .CloudTrailEvent | fromjson | select(.eventName=="Decrypt") | {time:.eventTime, arn:.userIdentity.arn, key:.requestParameters.keyId, requestId:.requestID}' raw_kms.json > kms_decrypts.ndjson

aws s3 cp s3://redwood-log-archive/k8s-audit/2023/2023-11-*.json.gz - | zcat | jq -c 'select(.objectRef.resource=="rolebindings" or .objectRef.resource=="clusterrolebindings") | select(.verb=="create" or .verb=="patch")' > k8s_rbac_events.ndjson

git log --pretty=format:'%H %cI %s' --since=2023-10-01 --until=2023-12-31 infra/roles > git_iam_commits.txt

Diego Alvarez: Anchor example I'll include in CSV: commit 9b7f2a -> PR #612 merged 2023-11-03T09:12:45Z -> k8s RoleBinding patch 2023-11-03T09:13:10Z (user: system:serviceaccount:prod:webhook-sa) -> CloudTrail Decrypt 2023-11-03T09:13:14Z by arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/webhook-role/webhook-sa (requestId: a1b2c3).

Priya Singh: Packaging checklist: run everything on ephemeral bastion, gzip outputs, compute sha256sums, upload to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/2023-q4/rbac-kms-mini-bundle/<run-id>/, include manifest.txt listing commands, tool versions, host fingerprint, and note redaction fields.

Diego Alvarez: Requesting temporary s3 read for s3://redwood-log-archive/cloudtrail/2023/* to run CloudTrail exports.

Nora Li: Created temporary role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/diego-audit-3h with 3h expiry. Posting policy in ticket.

Diego Alvarez: Done. Uploaded artifacts (redacted): kms_decrypts.ndjson.gz, k8s_rbac_events.ndjson.gz (excerpts), git_iam_commits.txt, principal_mapping_2023Q4.csv (columns: principal_arn,internal_service_account,commit_id,k8s_event_time,kms_event_time,kms_request_id,evidence_path,redaction_status), manifest.txt, checksums.txt. All sha256s verified.

Priya Singh: Confirmed redaction and manifest. Redaction key in vault path, accessible to engagement lead.

Olga (Auditor): Received bundle and reviewed anchor example. Acceptable. One minor ask: add a short note about how you ensured event times are comparable (NTP checks or kubelet/journal snapshots).

Nora Li: Added NTP output and kubelet time checks to manifest and re-uploaded. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
